|errata_history=This is the original (version 2 of 5, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Playtest''' ([[Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: 0 side [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred-original.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/maketenmenfeellikeahundred.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”], no mark). Text: “If Stardust on table, deploy on table. Saw is a Resistance Agent and spy. Once per game, may ▼ Saw. Rebel spies are deploy -1. Once per battle, if you just drew a Rebel spy for destiny, may retrieve 1 Force. Nightfall is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Original''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: 0 side [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/maketenmenfeellikeahundred.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”], no mark). Text: “If Stardust on table, deploy on table. Saw is a Resistance Agent and spy. Once per game, may ▼ Saw. Rebel spies are deploy -1. Once per battle, if you just drew a Rebel spy for destiny, may retrieve 1 Force. Nightfall is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' on release day the art background changed from the green forest to an interior wall; same words.
*: [[File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred (Errata)]], 12 July 2020): Players Committee card image, 12 July 2020: 0 side [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred-20200712.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/fdfe14b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/maketenmenfeellikeahundred.gif Holotable commit fdfe14b “March Errata Images”], mark “E”). Text: “If Stardust on table, deploy on table. Saw is a Resistance Agent and spy. Once per game, may ▼ Saw. Rebel spies deploy -1 to Scarif. Once per battle, if you just drew a Rebel spy for destiny, may retrieve 1 Force. Nightfall is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Rebel spies are deploy -1” became “Rebel spies deploy -1 to Scarif”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred (Errata 2)]], 14 October 2020): Players Committee card image, 14 October 2020: 0 side [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred-20201014.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d5f24d6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/maketenmenfeellikeahundred.gif Holotable commit d5f24d6 “oct 2020 errata”], mark “E”). Text: “If Stardust on table, deploy on table. Nightfall is canceled. Saw is a spy. Rebel spies deploy -1 to Scarif. Once per battle, if you just drew a Rebel spy for destiny, may retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Saw is a Resistance Agent and spy. Once per game, may ▼ Saw.” became “Saw is a spy.”; “Nightfall is canceled.” moved to follow “deploy on table.” '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred (Errata 3)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: 0 side [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/maketenmenfeellikeahundred.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”], mark “E1”). Text: “If Stardust on table, deploy on table. Nightfall is canceled. Saw is a spy. Rebel spies deploy -1 to Scarif. Once per battle, if you just drew a Rebel spy for destiny, may retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; mark now “E1”, copyright line now “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, re-rendered. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
